top_5_topics.title: Supreme Court Verdict on Electoral Bonds Scheme
top_5_topics.summary: The Supreme Court struck down the Electoral Bonds Scheme, declaring it unconstitutional as it violated the Right to Information under Article 19(1)(a). The court mandated SBI to disclose transaction details.

top_5_topics.title: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEEC) & Red Sea Disruptions
top_5_topics.summary: Maritime security threats in the Red Sea have accelerated discussions around alternative trade routes, highlighting strategic necessity and challenges facing the proposed IMEEC framework.

top_5_topics.title: Great Nicobar Island Infrastructure Project & Environmental Concerns
top_5_topics.summary: The mega infrastructure project on Great Nicobar Island faces scrutiny regarding forest diversion, impact on the Shompen and Nicobarese indigenous tribes, and threat to giant leatherback turtle nesting sites.

top_5_topics.title: Retail Inflation (CPI) Trends & RBI Monetary Policy Stance
top_5_topics.summary: The Reserve Bank of India maintained the repo rate status quo to anchor Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation within the target band of 4% (+/- 2%), driven primarily by food price volatility.

top_5_topics.title: Aditya-L1 Mission and Solar Physics Discoveries
top_5_topics.summary: ISRO's Aditya-L1 satellite successfully executed halo-orbit insertion around the Sun-Earth Lagrange Point 1 (L1), providing continuous observation of coronal mass ejections and solar winds.
